name: agentavow-trust
description: Signed, verifiable safety grades for the tools your agent connects to. Bundles the AgentAvow MCP connector (scan any MCP server, package, or repo for a signed 0-100 trust score and an adoption score), a /scan command, a skill that scans a server or package before Claude adds or installs it, and a session-start hook that grades newly added MCP servers (warn-only, fail-open).
